proposals.mechanism: Actual enabled inventory tick freezes nearby source water to packed ice and source lava to obsidian, records each position in the staff persistent set before setBlockAndUpdate. Every valid server inventory tick2 calls meltBlocks even when disabled. Loaded positions outside near-player region are checked: only matching packed-ice/obsidian state removes receipt and restores fixed source fluid. Current item component is an outstanding cleanup obligation coupled to real world changes, not a GUI selection cache.
proposals.dedup: Wizardry b236 already owns per-world phase history with original block ID/metadata and scheduled rewind; this proposal is not another history serializer. Incremental boundary is cleanup ownership transferred with a portable ItemStack, keeping receipts when chunks unload and consuming only on recognized material match; its dimensionless/missing-provenance limits demonstrate that persisting rollback intent alone is insufficient. Source fluid is material mutation rather than earned permanent progress. IceMagus charge and generic enabled bit already covered elsewhere and add0; one set family, not per fluid.
limits: FROZEN_POSITIONS contains BlockPos only; inventory tick uses current holder Level with no saved originating dimension. Moving item between dimensions can inspect same-coordinate blocks in another world; static risk, no runtime test.

No original block snapshot or provenance token. Only current exact default packed-ice or obsidian state checked; unrelated matching replacement could be thawed, and missing/changed blocks leave stale pending entries indefinitely.
Records position before block change; removes position before fluid replacement; setBlockAndUpdate success is unchecked in both directions. This is not acknowledged/atomic rollback.

No chunk loading requested: unloaded positions retained. Removed staff/no valid player/spectator disables cleanup; server tick calls only while in player inventory. No autonomous world manager obligation proven.
Freeze path has no snowball charge debit; parent snowball spending applies projectile/melee separately, so do not label cleanup as prepaid fuel or paid growth.

SetCodec constructs deduplicated immutable result, collects error remainder and sets partial result. Outer native ItemStack component decode policy not inspected; no guarantee malformed coordinates survive partial decode.
Native BlockPos codec/component framework and runtime are not executed; only local fixed mod declaration and actual consumers verified.

proposals.mechanism: Reload selects actual nonempty magazine inventory item, copies its registry type and potion contents to gun components, shrinks1 magazine and returns fresh empty magazine; gun receives8 stored rounds. Firing requires registered factory, spawns typed shot carrying potion contents, then decrements count and returns casing; when last round spent potion cleared. Actual shot hit applies stored instant or duration effects; projectile has potion compound pair.
proposals.dedup: Already accepted Vampirism824 paid-magazine persistent component and ammo payload consumer is stronger full-stack custody. Reliquary scalar count/type plus shared potion data is a concrete supporting comparison, not a new magazine count or credit per ammo/potion. Related charge e813 and lavaf776 already cover material budget carriers, so no new general-resource credit.
limits: BULLET_COUNT is raw Codec.SHORT without count validation, missing0; MAGAZINE_TYPE optional and no fallback to valid registered factory. Positive count with absent/unregistered type can remain unfireable.
Ammo not represented by full original magazine stack: unknown components/custom name are not copied to gun; empty magazine/casings are fresh.
Reload has no explicit client/server guard inside releaseUsing; observed automatic onUseTick caller is server-gated but does not prove every release callback server-only.
Shot spawn success unchecked; decrement follows invocation rather than acknowledged entity add. Not transactional paid ammo preservation.
Only exact magazine inventory consumption traced; upstream magazine crafting/payment recipe not inspected and no recipe provenance claim made.
Native component codec implementation not in pinned source; mod persistent registrations and actual getter/setter/consumer verified only.
